Left-joins every Montgomery tract to pre-aggregated pharmacy counts and returns tracts with zero listed pharmacies, ordered by count then tract name.
sql:
WITH tract_pharmacy_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, SUM(n) AS pharmacy_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_3a4e21' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(c.pharmacy_count, 0) AS pharmacy_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN tract_pharmacy_counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
WHERE COALESCE(c.pharmacy_count, 0) = 0
ORDER BY pharmacy_count ASC, t.name ASC
